body.x: 4IND will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its BOM Smart City Platform.

An official said, “4IND supports the construction of customized smart city solutions based on customer needs on a platform that can be integrated with various core technologies. It is also compatible with big data, and it supports systemic management. We also have sufficient price competitiveness."

He continued, “We built smart city pilot project made by considering the intelligent transportation system and safety of pedestrians in Malaysia, and we also constructed intelligent crosswalk system in Gumi. With the advanced technology development and various demonstrations, we are preparing with local companies to participate in smart city projects in Malaysia and Indonesia in 2020, and we are preparing intelligent safety diagnosis services for buildings, bridges and tunnels with a Singapore company."

He added, "4IND is providing customized smart city features to small and medium-sized communities with the experts in artificial intelligence, image processing, 5G applications and cloud services. We will continue to work on global projects with many companies in the future.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
